title: Additive functors between preadditive categories
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be preadditive categories [def-weil-preadditive-category]. A functor $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ is *additive* if for all objects $x,y$ of $\mathcal A$ the map $F:\mathrm{Mor}_{\mathcal A}(x,y)\to\mathrm{Mor}_{\mathcal B}(F(x),F(y))$ is a homomorphism of abelian groups, i.e. $F(f+g)=F(f)+F(g)$ for all $f,g:x\to y$.
